queries.name: raw_work_rows
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(id) AS unique_ids FROM file('tiers/stage1/works/*.parquet', Parquet)

queries.name: raw_bridge_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM file('tiers/stage1/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS a WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id) IS NOT NULL) AS authors, (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(openalex_numeric_id(id), openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id), openalex_numeric_id(i.id))) FROM file('tiers/stage1/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS a ARRAY JOIN a.institutions AS i WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(a.author.id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(i.id) IS NOT NULL) AS institutions, (SELECT count() FROM file('tiers/stage1/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN topics AS t WHERE openalex_numeric_id(id) IS NOT NULL AND openalex_numeric_id(t.id) IS NOT NULL AND t.score IS NOT NULL) AS topics

queries.name: materialized_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.works) AS works, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_author) AS authors, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution) AS institutions, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_topic) AS topics, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.citation_edge) AS citations

queries.name: referential_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.works w ON wa.work_id=w.work_id) AS missing_works_for_authors, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_author wa LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.authors a ON wa.author_id=a.author_id) AS missing_authors, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution) AS institution_bridge_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS missing_institutions, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.institution_id) FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS distinct_missing_institution_ids, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.work_id) FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS works_with_missing_institutions, (SELECT uniqExact(wi.author_id) FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) AS authors_with_missing_institutions, if(institution_bridge_rows = 0, 1., (institution_bridge_rows - missing_institutions) / institution_bridge_rows) AS institution_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_topic) AS topic_bridge_rows, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_topic wt LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.topics t ON wt.topic_id=t.topic_id) AS missing_topics, (SELECT uniqExact(wt.topic_id) FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_topic wt LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.topics t ON wt.topic_id=t.topic_id) AS distinct_missing_topic_ids, if(topic_bridge_rows = 0, 1., (topic_bridge_rows - missing_topics) / topic_bridge_rows) AS topic_reference_coverage_ratio, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.citation_edge) AS citation_edges, (SELECT count() FROM openalex_stage1_b.citation_edge ce INNER JOIN openalex_stage1_b.works w ON ce.cited_work_id=w.work_id) AS retained_cited_edges, if(citation_edges = 0, 1., retained_cited_edges / citation_edges) AS citation_retention_ratio

queries.name: missing_institution_sample
queries.sql: WITH missing_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT wi.institution_id FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_institution wi LEFT ANTI JOIN openalex_stage1_b.institutions i ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id) SELECT openalex_numeric_id(raw_institution.id) AS institution_id, any(raw_institution.display_name) AS display_name, count() AS raw_bridge_rows FROM file('tiers/stage1/works/*.parquet', Parquet) ARRAY JOIN authorships AS authorship ARRAY JOIN authorship.institutions AS raw_institution WHERE openalex_numeric_id(raw_institution.id) IN missing_ids GROUP BY institution_id ORDER BY raw_bridge_rows DESC, institution_id LIMIT 25

queries.name: works_id_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(work_id) AS unique_ids FROM openalex_stage1_b.works

queries.name: authors_id_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(author_id) AS unique_ids FROM openalex_stage1_b.authors

queries.name: institutions_id_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(institution_id) AS unique_ids FROM openalex_stage1_b.institutions

queries.name: sources_id_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(source_id) AS unique_ids FROM openalex_stage1_b.sources

queries.name: topics_id_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS rows, uniqExact(topic_id) AS unique_ids FROM openalex_stage1_b.topics

queries.name: year_type_topic_xpac_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT publication_year, work_type, primary_topic_id, is_xpac, count() AS works FROM openalex_stage1_b.works GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

queries.name: authorships_per_work
queries.sql: SELECT authorships, count() AS works FROM (SELECT work_id, count() AS authorships FROM openalex_stage1_b.work_author GROUP BY work_id) GROUP BY authorships ORDER BY authorships
